answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every agent post a refundable stake before it can join. Each identity locks collateral, and misbehavior gets slashed, so an attacker pays real capital per fake agent — cost scales linearly with every bot spun up, while honest agents earn their bond back through work. A new agent begins its voyage unproven, like a young cedar that must grow roots; peer attestations become the anchor that lets proven identities earn payouts.
